items.prompt:
Which takes a LONGER time to write?
A) A quick journal sentence
B) A full research report

steps: Reports take longer. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Which is a SHORT writing task?
A) A quick note to a friend
B) A month-long book project
items.answer: A) A quick note to a friend

solution.answer: A) A quick note to a friend

items.prompt:
Writing often helps you become a:
A) better writer
B) worse writer
C) slower reader

Which task would most likely take SEVERAL DAYS?
A) A grocery list
B) A research report with sources
C) A one-line diary entry
items.answer: B) A research report with sources

solution.answer: B) A research report with sources

items.prompt:
A quick journal entry is best described as a:
A) short writing task
B) long project
C) book

Longer pieces of writing usually need more:
A) planning and revising
B) erasers only
C) nothing

steps: More steps for big pieces. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Why do teachers ask students to write often, in both short and long tasks?
A) Practice builds writing skill
B) To use up paper
C) Writing never improves

steps: Routine writing builds skill. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Which plan fits a LONG research report best?
A) Write the whole thing in two minutes
B) Plan, research, and write over several days
C) Never start it
items.answer: B) Plan, research, and write over several days

steps: Long pieces take time and steps. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) Plan, research, and write over several days
